name: Band Standing Hip Abduction
steps: Tie a band low on a post and stand side-on, the post at your left.
Loop the band around your right ankle so it crosses in front of your left leg.
Hold the post and stand tall.
Lift the right leg out to the side with a straight knee.
Return slowly. Finish the set, then switch sides.
cues: Lift from the side of the hip

common_mistakes.fix: Keep shoulders level and take a smaller lift
Control the leg on the way in
